currentRoundInspection.method: One inspected picture and standard viewer PMTiles.
currentRoundInspection.placement: One inspected VisitKorea picture confirms the tall inclined H towers, suspension line, narrow twin roadway and shoreline context. Standard viewer PMTiles paired bridge roads and bay agree with the retained near-north/south foundation-centred frame. Retain2260m suspended deck,1545m central span and2545m cable anchorage spacing; longer3794.742m map approach extent is separate. Source sea-level0m agrees with coarse mapped bay samples. Deck height/vertical curve, foundation pads, tides and terminal joins remain approximate; adjoining mainland/Myodo approach roads are supplied by the viewer and are outside this model.
